text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Another victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And another step closer to seizing my<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho already in hand,<n>this makes
two crowns. Symboli<n>Rudolf raises her hand high,
two<n>fingers pointing skyward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Two crowns claimed. One to go.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Rudolf! Rudolf! Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With this victory, a new Derby<n>Champion is
born—and with Rudolf<n>now poised to claim the Triple
Crown,<n>the crowd's excitement can't be<n>contained.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Their elation is infectious, quickly<n>spreading to
every last person...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Including a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Two crowns! Congratulations,<n>President. I must
say, you raced<n>splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's so funny?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. I've just never seen you<n>with your
cheeks so red before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I took part in the Derby for<n>that alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please don't tease me. Is it wrong to<n>get a little
sentimental when a friend<n>accomplishes something
so great?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I only hope you'll greet me<n>with twice the
enthusiasm after my<n>next race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mean...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But of course. My next goal is to<n>challenge the
Kikuka Sho and claim<n>the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Next stop, the Kikuka Sho. Symboli<n>Rudolf's goal is
so close I can<n>practically taste it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Surely you realize that this will strain<n>your schedule
to the limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Summer may be coming, but you will<n>have more
press interviews than<n>ever. And naturally, the
student<n>council will be—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm listening. Please, continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With respect, you do look rather tired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Forgive me. Even I can't<n>maintain perfect
form after a race like<n>that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you should refrain from<n>student council
work for a little—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe we have already discussed<n>that point.
Let's move on to<n>something more constructive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To pick up on your earlier point, the<n>student council
has important work to<n>do come the summer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come now, Trainer. Surely you<n>haven't forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every year, the academy holds a<n>summer camp to
help the students<n>improve their racing skills. The
student council helps to organize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah yes, that reminds me. Air Groove,<n>can you
contact the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We need to change the number of<n>buses we'll be
hiring, and there are<n>also some other issues I want
to<n>discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That being said, the press is outside,<n>and I can
hardly keep them waiting.<n>Let's see now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back at the academy in two<n>hours. Could you
set up the meeting<n>for when I return?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Even with the Japanese Derby under<n>her belt,
Symboli Rudolf shows no<n>signs of relaxing her
unforgiving<n>schedule.
